subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “It brought back skill, memory, and possibility.”?
options: Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.
What feels old now was once powerful enough to change how people imagined the world.
Repair can reconnect people not only with objects, but with the hands that once used them.
A repair culture helps people see objects as systems, not trash waiting to happen.
